name: chaos-day
description: A busy test day: a stranger arrives in the morning, Greta's ledger vanishes from her house and turns up hidden in Tomas's, a whisper, and an explosion in the Tilted Cup around midday. For a full replay, reseed the scenario first (Reseed, dev only) and use the same seed.

actions.comment: the stranger: a dormant scenario character walks into the village

actions.text: Flour is missing again. Someone has been in your storeroom in the night.

actions.comment: Greta's ledger is moved out of her house and hidden under Tomas's bed
seeded choice: whichever alternative the seed picks is the one that happens

actions.text: You can't stop thinking about the dice game last night. One more throw and you'd have won it all back.
actions.comment: only fires half the time: compare two runs with different seeds
midday: the powder keg behind the bar goes up
a long day catches up with the baker

actions.reason: Tomas was seen near her house the very day her ledger went missing.

actions.comment: a bad end to a bad day for the apprentice
